concepts.subject: Diverse Team Meeting Room
concepts.image_prompt: Generate a modern conference room with a diverse team of professionals, natural light, warm colors, and a relaxed mood. Capture from a slightly elevated angle, with a mix of seated and standing individuals, and a cityscape outside the window. Incorporate a large wooden table, comfortable chairs, and a few laptops.
concepts.title: Diverse Team Collaborating in Office
concepts.description: A group of diverse professionals gathered around a conference table, engaging in a discussion and taking notes. The room is modern and well-lit, with a city view outside the window.

concepts.subject: Active Senior Hiking Outdoors
concepts.image_prompt: Create a scenic outdoor scene featuring an active senior citizen hiking on a trail, surrounded by lush greenery and a clear blue sky. Use a warm and natural lighting style, with a slight golden hour glow. Capture from a low angle, looking up at the subject, with a walking stick and hiking boots visible.
concepts.title: Active Senior Hiking in Nature
concepts.description: An active senior citizen walking on a hiking trail, surrounded by lush green trees and a clear blue sky. The subject is dressed in outdoor gear, including hiking boots and a walking stick.
